title: JetSpec++: Foresight Parallel Drafting with Self Refinements
abstract: arXiv:2610.19792v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding's effectiveness is governed by two quantities: the acceptance rate of drafted tokens and the cost of producing them. We show the two objectives can be co-optimized with algorithm-system co-design, and present JetSpec++, which retains a strong learned draft model while hiding its cost almost entirely. JetSpec++ combines three components: intra-block self refinement, which trains the draft model to iteratively correct its own parallel predictions within a block of tokens; inter-block foresight drafting, which begins the next block before the current one is verified; and pipelined drafting and verification, which overlaps the two stages so drafting's marginal wall-clock cost approaches zero. translated_title: JetSpec++：具有自我精炼的前瞻式并行草稿生成
translated_abstract: 推测解码的有效性由两个量决定：草稿token的接受率和生成它们的成本。我们证明这两个目标可以通过算法-系统协同设计来共同优化，并提出JetSpec++，它在保留强大学习型草稿模型的同时，几乎完全隐藏了其成本。JetSpec++结合了三个组件：块内自精炼，训练草稿模型在token块内迭代修正自己的并行预测；块间前瞻草稿生成，在当前块被验证之前就开始生成下一个块；以及流水线化的草稿生成与验证，使两个阶段相互重叠，从而使草稿生成的边际墙钟时间成本趋近于零。与最先进的推测解码方法相比，JetSpec++相对自回归（AR）解码实现了高达7.45倍的墙钟加速，相对DSpark实现了1.54倍的加速，吞吐量高达每秒1,361个token。
tldr: JetSpec++通过块内自精炼、块间前瞻草稿生成和流水线化草稿生成与验证的算法-系统协同设计，几乎完全隐藏草稿模型的开销，实现最高7.45倍于自回归解码的加速。
en_tdlr: JetSpec++ leverages algorithm-system co-design—combining intra-block self refinement, inter-block foresight drafting, and pipelined drafting/verification—to almost entirely hide the draft model's cost, achieving up to 7.45× wall-clock speedup over autoregressive decoding.
